note: Small access on the Marmaton River northeast of Nevada, with a seasonal concrete boat ramp (the river is unusable at low flow). The camping spot is a mowed opening just north of the gravel lot at the end of the access road, reached by gravel county roads with no river crossing. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' (free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit). One GIS camping point (47 = stored pin), a ~30 x 25 m mowed opening beside a ~45 x 25 m gravel lot (GIS 390) with a privy. Route is Route D -> CR 1500 south -> gravel access road east; no ford or river crossing. Pin fine; not waterfront kept (~60 m through woods to the river); phone matches; vault_toilets written from the map.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'. The 1/26/2022 map shows one Primitive Camping symbol, a Privy and a Parking Lot at the end of the MDC improved road. GIS camping point 47 (= stored pin) sits in a mowed grass opening ~30 x 25 m just north of the gravel lot (GIS 390, ~45 x 25 m). A 23-ft rig fits on the lot or the opening's edge.

FORD CHECK: no ford on the route. From I-49 exit Route D, go east, then south on gravel Vernon County Road 1500, which turns east into the MDC access road and ends at the lot and ramp. The road stays on the north bank and never crosses the river; the name refers to the old river crossing. The gravel roads are graded county roads, with no 4WD note anywhere.
PIN: stored 37.94971,-94.35554 = GIS camping point 47, on the mowed opening - fine.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): the camping opening is ~60 m from the Marmaton through a wooded bank. Only the boat-ramp lane reaches the water, and that doesn't count.
PHONE: (417) 853-4592 on the area page matches.
Note rewritten: acreage, generic MDC text and directions dropped.
